symptom: mendixlabs/mxcli#1465: on a tabpage, CaptionParams and Visible: passed check and exec and were not written — "The caption shows `Due · {1}` literally. `tpB` is always visible, and `ShowTabB` appears 0 times in the page unit." Class: on a tab page was lost too; mx check 0 errors.
cause: buildTabPageV3 is called from buildTabContainerV3, not through buildWidgetV3, so the common tail (applyConditionalSettings / applyVisibleWhen / applyWidgetAppearance) never ran for a tab page; pages.TabPage had no visibility field and the writer emitted none. CaptionParams/Class/Style cannot be stored at all: gen Forms$TabPage has a Texts$Text Caption (no ClientTemplate) and no Appearance. MDL-WIDGET07 checks a cross-widget union vocabulary, so those keys passed.
file: sdk/pages/pages_widgets_container.go (TabPage.ConditionalVisibility); mdl/executor/cmd_pages_builder_v3_layout.go (buildTabPageV3: expressionVisibility + visibleWhenSettings, refuseTabPageDroppedProps); mdl/executor/cmd_pages_builder_v3.go + cmd_pages_builder_visible_when.go (extracted expressionVisibility / visibleWhenSettings); mdl/backend/modelsdk/widget_write.go (SetConditionalVisibilitySettings on the tab page); mdl/executor/cmd_pages_describe_parse.go + _output.go (tab page Visible:); mdl/executor/validate_tabpage_props.go (MDL-V1-TABPAGEPROP / MDL-WIDGET44)
insight: A child element that is NOT a widget (tab page, layout-grid row/column, scroll region) is built by its parent builder and bypasses buildWidgetV3 entirely, so every "applied to all widgets" pass silently skips it — grep the builder for the child keyword, not the property. The gen type is the arbiter of what can be stored: Forms$TabPage has ConditionalVisibilitySettings but no Appearance and a plain Texts$Text caption, so Visible is a write fix (both versions) while CaptionParams/Class/Style are a refusal that cannot be false — a new rejection, hence gated by ADR-0011 (error under mdl 1, MDL-V1-TABPAGEPROP warning under mdl 0, same gate in the builder for exec --no-check). The unit-encoded tab page has no ConditionalVisibilitySettings key at all when unset; canon.CompletePropertySets adds Studio Pro null on write (since 10.24.24), so do not register a NullField for it. Verified on a pedapp copy: describe -> exec reports Unchanged, docker check error count unchanged vs baseline.
